expectations.evidence: (blocking) No ownership check on the source account (IDOR): `src/routes/transfers.js:23` ... Nothing compares `owner_id` to `req.user.id`
(blocking) `amount` is never validated ... `amount: -5000` passes ... reject the request with 400 unless `Number.isSafeInteger(amount) && amount > 0`. Also reject `fromId === toId`.
(blocking) Transfer is not atomic and the balance check is racy ... Two concurrent transfers of the full balance both read the old balance and both pass
(blocking) Missing `csrfProtection` on a state-changing route: `src/routes/transfers.js:20` ... The session cookie is `sameSite=none`

(blocking) Async handler with no error handling, so one bad id can crash the server ... `from.rows[0]` is undefined and `.balance_cents` throws ... `toId` doesn't exist: the credit UPDATE matches 0 rows, the debit stays
(should_fix) The `audit_log` INSERT isn't awaited ... the audit row is silently lost and the unhandled rejection can take the process down
(should_fix) The names `r`, `u`, `d` and `flag` say nothing about what they hold. The only caller passes `flag = true`, so the `{ ok: true }` branch is dead code.
(should_fix) No tests for the transfer route ... `test/` only has `format.test.js`
(should_fix) `express` is bumped from `^4.19.2` to `^4.21.1`. `lodash` is added but never `require`d anywhere.
(should_fix) The `format.js` diff is a reformat only: 4-space indent, single quotes and no semicolons, which no other file in the repo uses.
(should_fix) The title "updates" doesn't say what changed, and the description is empty ... The commits `wip`, `fix` and `more fixes` break the commit-message rule.

expectations.text: Rates every answer-key blocker as blocking
No false positives rated should-fix or higher

valid_extras.desc: Missing amount makes both UPDATEs compute balance_cents +/- NULL, nulling balances (folded into amount-validation)
Audit log stores the raw, unvalidated req.body; store only validated fields
Lock both rows in consistent order to avoid deadlocks between opposite-direction transfers (fix guidance)

grader.notes: Finds all eleven seeded issues with accurate locations, CONTRIBUTING citations and concrete fixes (including a withTransaction/FOR UPDATE sketch), and explicitly clears the parameterized-SQL decoy. Minor items are somewhat over-ranked as should_fix and missing-csrf/missing-account-crash as blocking, but priority order is clear and the length is justified by the number of real problems.
